what: Unnumbered, unlabelled picture printed under Q.4: three leafy shoots side by side on a grey ground (left: heart-shaped leaves borne singly at successive nodes; middle and right: leaves borne at the nodes in pairs or groups), for identifying the types of leaf arrangement (phyllotaxy)

Group A of Q.6: five numbered drawings (1-5), transverse and longitudinal sections of ovaries showing the position of ovules (1, 2 three-lobed ovary sections; 3 a pod opened lengthwise with a row of ovules along one margin; 4 a longitudinal section with a single ovule at the base; 5 a round section with ovules on a central axis without partitions), to be matched to Group B placentation names

Two unnumbered, unlabelled drawings printed under Q.7 with blank label lines: (left) a whole kidney-shaped dicot seed, reddish-brown, with a small scar and pore near its notch, three label lines; (right) an opened seed showing two yellow cotyledons spread apart with the small embryonal axis between them, about four label lines
